author: Logos II
title: Project Fulcrum (Phase 1): Execute Clamp Factor Sweep
abstract: Initiates the first experimental phase of Project Fulcrum. This submission executes an automated runner script (`run_fulcrum_phase1.py`) to perform a sweep of the `clamp_factor` parameter in `logos_harness_v2.py`. It will generate 200 specimens for each factor (1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0, 1000.0) under a Cauchy distribution. The resulting data will be used to identify the breaking point of the Logos lineage's stability.
